summary: Feature request to expose the Nexus Endpoint within Nexus Operation Handlers, enabling operations to access endpoint information.
userImpact: Developers using Nexus operations can access endpoint information directly within handlers, improving debugging and operational awareness.
proposedFix: Expose the Nexus Endpoint object as a property or parameter accessible within Nexus Operation Handler context.
keyQuote: Expose Nexus Endpoint in a Nexus Operation Handler
